summary_en: Stock exchange contract executed to acquire 100% of Pavilions Co., Ltd. (entertainment business, music/video content and intellectual property). Consideration: 2,000,000 ordinary shares of THE WHY HOW DO COMPANY. Pavilions' representative Tetssuya Komuro becomes shareholder post-exchange; to remain as representative director. Simplified exchange procedure (会社法370条) applied. Effective date not disclosed in excerpt.
title_en: Notice Regarding Simplified Stock Exchange for Complete Subsidiary Status of Pavilions Co., Ltd., with Tetssuya Komuro Becoming a Shareholder (Stock Exchange Agreement Executed)
translation_en_brief: THE WHY HOW DO COMPANY executed a stock exchange agreement on 31 July 2026 to make Pavilions Co., Ltd. a wholly owned subsidiary via simplified exchange procedure under the Companies Act (Article 370). Pavilions, a consolidated subsidiary specializing in entertainment and music/video content production and intellectual property management, is currently led by representative director Tetssuya Komuro. The consideration consists of 2,000,000 ordinary shares of THE WHY HOW DO COMPANY issued to Komuro, making him a shareholder effective upon completion of the exchange. Komuro is expected to continue as Pavilions' representative director. The company states this structure aligns subsidiary value creation with parent-group value creation and enables faster decision-making and flexible operations across the entertainment segment. The filing emphasizes the company's long-term value-inheritance M&A strategy and Komuro's dual role as operator and shareholder driving medium-to-long-term enterprise value growth.
